predictions:
Make memory pool stream-aware to avoid illegal reuse

Each allocation now tracks its owning CUDA stream; free lists are keyed
by stream handle so blocks are only reused on the same stream.  
Async copy helpers default to the current stream when none is supplied.

Unify and expand ndimage filter tests

Factor multiple sparse test classes into one reusable base with
parameterized filter types, modes, shapes and dtypes.  Covers
convolve/correlate (1D/ND), minimum/maximum_filter (1D/ND), new
footprint, axis, dtype and weight combinations plus edge-case checks for
zero-dim weights, invalid modes/origins/axes.

Replace dynamic imports with direct top-level numpy import

Change all runtime relative imports to a single static `import numpy as np` at the top of each module. Each wrapper function now calls `np.<func>` directly instead of repeatedly importing from the parent package.
Switch array API wrappers to use NumPy's _implementation helpers

Align array API wrappers with spec and add type annotations

Update signatures to accept either tuples or lists for concat/stack, allow Array objects in asarray, and replace direct returns from finfo/iinfo with strict dataclass wrappers. Add correct return-type hints to Array properties and __len__.

Enforce left/right shift return dtype via dtype rule, not cast

The Array API mandates that bitwise left- and right-shifts preserve the dtype of the first argument.  
Switch from an explicit `.astype()` after the operation to using `_normalize_two_args`, which already handles the required dtype promotion rule.

Replace NumPy's result_type with spec-compliant rules

Adds a custom promotion table and _result_type helper so result_type()
only allows the type combinations defined by the array API standard,
eliminating non-standard NumPy behaviour such as int64+uint64→float64.

Add orphaned-item cleanup before watchers run

Missing latest_revision_id records can accumulate when items vanish from
the cloud but are never explicitly deleted.  A new helper
fix_orphaned_deletions() now scans for such “orphaned” items and creates
a synthetic deletion revision for each, ensuring the item is properly
marked as deleted in downstream reports.  The check is invoked in both
find_changes and reporter_logic.  Also quiets noisy botocore loggers and
removes duplicate SQS queue listings.

Add CloudWatch metrics for scanning performance

Enables optional posting of queue-item counts to CloudWatch when
objects are added to or removed from the scanning queue.

Replace string concatenation with format templates

Replace ad-hoc %s substitutions in ninja rule generation with
named placeholders and str.format to improve readability and
reduce quoting/escaping errors across all compiler and linker
rules.

Centralize custom target template substitution

Replace the inline template expansion in Backend.eval_custom_target_command with a single call to the new mesonlib.substitute_values, which handles all @INPUT@ / @OUTPUT@ / @OUTDIR@ replacements uniformly and adds stricter validation for invalid placeholders.
Merge C and C++ compiler detection into shared helper

Introduce enum for dependency detection methods

Replace raw strings with a proper enum to improve type safety, enforce
allowed values, and make the code more maintainable.

Use proper capitalized language names in logs and ninja

Adds get_display_language() so C++, C#, Objective-C, etc. appear correctly in all messages.

Add ConfigToolDependency for 'program-config' style tools

Introduce a new ExternalDependency subclass that locates and queries
*-config programs (e.g., pcap-config) for version checks and compile
flags. Can be requested explicitly via the new `config-tool` method or
used automatically when other methods fail.

Enable cross-file lookup on all non-Windows platforms

Stop restricting system-wide cross-file search to Linux/BSD; any non-Windows host now follows the XDG path sequence. Add test skip for Windows where the feature is still unsupported.

Enable relative import_dirs for D string imports

Delay applying D feature arguments until ninja backend so that
d_import_dirs can be interpreted relative to the source tree and
properly quoted for the compiler command line.

Allow per-test options and isolate test environments

Replace the global `global_env` with per-test environment assembly and
ensure each test receives its own copy of options, preventing shared
state leaks and enabling `--setup` to use project-specific definitions.

Replace ad-hoc path-sep checks with has_path_sep()

Centralize the slash/backslash detection logic into the new
mesonlib.has_path_sep() helper and reuse it everywhere we previously
did inline tests.

Extend OptionOverrideProxy to handle multiple option maps

Teach the proxy to accept any number of option dictionaries and consult them in order when looking up a value. Add dedicated helpers that construct proxies for built-in, base and compiler options, and fix the NDEBUG test to read the enum’s value.

Add libtool version to Darwin compatibility version logic

Pass the libtool version string down to the Darwin-specific install name
generation so that the compatibility_version and current_version fields
are computed from the full "major.minor.revision" triplet whenever it is
available.
Add install_mode parameter to control installed file permissions

Move option handling logic into CoreData

Relocate option merging and setting from Environment/Conf into
CoreData, simplifying the API and centralizing option management.

Rename all clike_* identifiers to clink_*

Replace the misleading “clike” terminology with “clink” to clarify that the
affected languages are those that can be linked directly with C object code,
not necessarily “C-like” in syntax or semantics.

Fix empty dependency name in log messages

Use "(anonymous)" instead of an empty string when the dependency name
is empty, making diagnostic and error output more readable.

Use dedicated deprecation log level for deprecations

Replace ad-hoc "DEPRECATION:" warnings with the newly introduced
mlog.deprecation() helper so that all deprecation notices appear
consistently.

Dedupe host-system checks behind new CrossBuildInfo helper

Replace repeated inline cross-file lookups with the new
get_host_system() helper.  This makes the intent clearer and keeps
cross/native logic consistent across Environment and mesonlib helpers.

Add runtime detection for fallback C++ standard flags

Replace brittle version-based remapping with real compiler tests to pick the best -std= flag. When the primary name (e.g. c++14) is rejected, the code now probes known fallbacks (e.g. c++1y) via a small compile-time test.

Replace loose compiler-type constants with CompilerType enum

Unify GCC_* / CLANG_* / ICC_* integer constants into a single CompilerType
enum.  All compiler classes now receive the same “compiler_type” argument
and use the new properties (is_osx_compiler, is_windows_compiler …)
instead of ad-hoc comparisons.  The change simplifies future additions
and makes compiler-type handling consistent across C/C++, Objective-C/C++,
Fortran and D.

unify subcommands under single argparse parser

Replace individual argument parsers and dispatch logic in each meson script with a single CommandLineParser class that registers all subcommands (setup, configure, install, etc.) and their argument builders.  Each subcommand now exposes an `add_arguments` helper and receives a pre-parsed options object.

Add automatic vcvars setup to VS regeneration

Generate the correct vcvarsall / VsDevCmd call during Visual Studio
solution regeneration so the build tree can be refreshed from any
command prompt.

Share LLVM tool name list generation

Move the hard-coded lists of LLVM tool names (llvm-config, scan-build) into a
single helper in environment.py so everything that needs to find an LLVM
executable uses the same ordered list of version suffixes.

Consolidate git wrapper into mesonlib

Moved the duplicated git() helper into mesonlib.py and updated all callers to import and use the centralized version, eliminating code repetition and ensuring consistent Windows ANSI handling across subprojects and wrap tools.

Simplify TestResult creation and failure tracking

Replace the large constructor with step-wise accumulation methods so each
stage (configure, build, test, install, clean) can append output and
record timing. Failures are now set explicitly instead of creating new
objects, keeping the single TestResult instance alive until the end.

Replace test protocol strings with TestProtocol enum

Use a dedicated enum instead of bare strings to represent the two
supported test protocols ("exitcode" and "tap").  This prevents typos
and makes protocol comparisons type-safe.

Purge also deletes wrap-redirect files and their targets

The `meson subprojects purge` command now removes both the
redirecting .wrap file and the .wrap file it points to, in addition to
the subproject and cached archives.  It also uses a safer directory
removal helper on Windows when deleting the packagecache.
Allow n_epochs to be a list and return intermediate embeddings

Update UHV wonder lists for France, America, and Mughals

Replace obsolete wonders in historical victory conditions with culturally representative replacements:  
- France: Statue of Liberty → Louvre + Metropolitain  
- Mughals: Harmandir Sahib → Shalimar Gardens  
- America: adds Brooklyn Bridge and Golden Gate Bridge

Add region selection to S3StorageDriver constructor

Allow choosing any AWS region when instantiating the driver by setting a new `region` parameter.  Region names are validated against a built-in mapping, the proper endpoint host is selected automatically, and error messages now report the expected and actual regions.

Make setup.py self-contained to avoid runtime deps

Inlined package discovery and data-file collection helpers (originally from Twisted) so setup.py no longer needs to import any libcloud modules.  
Reads __version__ directly from libcloud/__init__.py with regex instead of importing libcloud.  
Ensures tox dist checks run with a clean environment (empty deps).

Add range-based download methods for StorageDriver

Introduces `download_object_range` and `download_object_range_as_stream`
to allow partial object downloads.  Updates S3 and Local drivers to
support the new operations, configures the expected 206 response code,
and adjusts internal helpers to distinguish full vs. partial downloads.
Skipping size checks when dealing with range saves prevents false
integrity failures.

Add range download support to Azure Blobs

Introduces download_object_range() and download_object_range_as_stream() to AzureBlobsStorageDriver so blobs can be downloaded in parts. Moves the generic range-header helper _get_range_str to the StorageDriver base as _get_standard_range_str so both Azure and S3 reuse the same logic. Accept 206 Partial Content as a successful response for range requests.

Add optional timeout parameter to script deployments

Allow ScriptDeployment and ScriptFileDeployment to specify a maximum
run-time in seconds; the underlying SSH client will enforce it.

Handle XML responses with or without namespace gracefully

AWS responses sometimes omit the expected namespace.  
Introduce *ignore_namespace* versions of findtext and findall utilities, then switch AWS parsers to use them so error extraction succeeds regardless of namespace presence.

Add multi-version auth tests for OpenStack driver

Add comprehensive test class and mock helper to exercise every supported
OpenStack authentication version (2.0, 3.x_password, 3.x_oidc_access_token,
etc.) and verify the driver can successfully authenticate and list nodes
for each.
Add alias support and handle stdin in SQL store

Add SQL translation for Cypher CONCAT function

Introduce dedicated `function_call_to_sql` helper to unify handling of
all function calls. Special-case CONCAT so it maps to SQLite's `||`
operator. Update TODO by marking concat support as complete.

Add virtual graph support to KGTK query translation

- Introduce TranslationState helpers to track virtual tables
- Skip index generation on virtual table references
- Route virtual graph clauses through SqlFunction translator

Add option to disable SQL query optimizer

Introduces --dont-optimize flag to preserve original graph ordering and use CROSS/LEFT JOINs instead of relying on SQLite's optimizer. This helps debug queries where the planner chooses poor join orders.

Rename parameter ref_geom to geom for consistency

Standardize the parameter name across all relevant functions and classes to use `geom` instead of `ref_geom`.
Enforce unique auto-generated names for datasets and models

Add per-model switches to skip PSF and EDISP convolution

Allow turning off PSF or energy-dispersion application for individual
sky models via a new `processing` dict argument (keys “psf” and “edisp”).
Defaults keep the previous behavior (apply both when available).

Allow models to define multiple string tags

Replaced single string `tag` attributes with lists of strings so every
model can register both its canonical name and one or more short
aliases.  Serialization and registry lookup now use the first entry,
keeping backward compatibility while enabling shorthand identifiers in
user code and configuration files.

Add option to omit default parameter meta in YAML

Optionally drop min, max, frozen and error fields when they match the
parameter’s built-in defaults or are NaN, yielding smaller and cleaner
YAML output.  The new `full_output` flag (defaults to True) toggles this
behaviour in `Model.to_dict`, `Models.write`, and related helper
methods.

Add piecewise broken power-law spectral model

New model `PiecewiseBrokenPowerLawSpectralModel` allows a spectrum defined by
flux values at fixed energy nodes, with linear interpolation in log–log space
between nodes. Includes serialisation support and unit tests.

Support configurable comment markers in header and data sections

Clarify that both the header and data sections now respect the same
ignore_comments parameter, and document how to use it for custom
comment markers like "%MyComment".

Allow clean shutdown and auto-reload on config changes

Adds explicit stop/join methods to shut down both producer and consumer threads gracefully.  
Signals the recognizer to exit its wake-word wait loop immediately when stop() is called.  
Spawns recognizer threads as instance variables so we can wait for their termination.  
Introduces periodic config-hash checks in the main run loop and triggers a full reload when configuration is modified.

Add support for once-only event handlers

Introduce the `once` flag to `add_event` so intent handlers can be
automatically removed after first use. Also make scheduled one-shot
events use the new behavior, cleaning up their residual handlers and
preventing memory leaks.

Replace global decorator lists with per-method attributes

Stop relying on module-level lists _intent_list/_intent_file_list; instead store the pending parsers directly on the decorated method. This removes shared mutable state and allows any number of skill instances to register decorated handlers independently without clearing global variables.

Use skill folder names as string skill IDs

Switches all internal skill identifiers from numeric hashes to stable folder-name strings.  
Replaces the old digit-to-letter helper with `to_alnum`, which keeps only safe characters.  
Updates every place that cast IDs to int and every test that expected the old hash scheme.
Add seek forward/backward support to audio service

Stop syncing skill settings across devices

Remove cross-device synchronization logic and hash-based metadata versioning.  
Settings are now fetched and saved only for the current device using the skill's  
stable identifier, eliminating the need for hash comparison and `not_owner` flag.

Convert metaclass declarations to Py3 syntax

Replaces the legacy `__metaclass__ = ABCMeta` with the modern
`metaclass=ABCMeta` keyword argument in all abstract base classes.

Allow register_intent to accept .intent files

register_intent can now handle both Adapt and Padatious intents by accepting
an intent file name ending with '.intent', delegating to register_intent_file.
Deprecated intent_file_handler decorator in favor of intent_handler.

Split monolithic execute_test into smaller helpers

Extract test-loading, input dispatching, context handling, timeout logic and result reporting into focused methods.  Reduces method length and duplication while keeping behavior unchanged.

Move wake-word trigger to end of last TTS chunk

Instead of always queueing a wake-word after every chunk of speech when
expect_response is true, emit the "mycroft.mic.listen" message only after
the last chunk has finished playing. This prevents premature listening
and guarantees the full reply is spoken before the user can answer.
Split cache-curation logic into reusable helpers

Track original handlers to fix fallback removal

Ensure a fallback can be deregistered even when wrapped, by keeping a
(handler, wrapper) map and replacing direct comparisons with lookups.

Add MessageWaiter utility to simplify async waits

Introduce a reusable MessageWaiter class that encapsulates the setup and
handling for waiting on a single message, and expose it via the public
import path.

Refactor wait_for_response to use MessageWaiter internally, removing
duplicate wait logic and adding a new wait_for_message convenience
method that waits for any message of a given type.

Replace ad-hoc skills status messages with ProcessStatus

Adds a centralized ProcessStatus utility that tracks five distinct
states (NOT_STARTED → STARTED → ALIVE → READY → STOPPING) and
automatically emits the expected message-bus responses and lifecycle
callbacks.  The skills service now reports these states instead of the
hand-rolled on_ready / on_error / on_stopping hooks and removes the
redundant bus handlers from SkillManager.
Add configurable Windows FFmpeg DLL names via option ffmpeg_libs_win
Add AudioPacket and unify audio/video packet queuing with fillq

Replace worker thread with pyglet.clock scheduling

Eliminate the dedicated DirectSound worker thread and all RLock
synchronization by moving buffer-refill logic into a scheduled
interval function run on pyglet's main clock.  Removes the lock-
heavy code path and the custom __del__/delete cleanup, relying
instead on clock unscheduling for shutdown.

Emit on_eos on audio-less sources when audio driver is silent

When no audio driver is available and the source has no video track,
schedule a one-time clock callback that fires the "on_eos" event after
the clip’s duration, ensuring playback still ends cleanly.  
Remove assignment of None to self.source.audio_format and add test
coverage for the new behaviour.

Update CREATE POPULATION syntax for stattype clauses

Replace the ambiguous `MODEL col AS TYPE` form with the explicit `SET
STATTYPE[S] OF col[, ...] TO type` syntax and change `GUESS STATTYPES
FOR` to `GUESS STATTYPES OF` for consistency.

Add constraint support to column mutual information

The method now honours the `constraints` argument by sampling any
missing values, converting the full conditioning row into loom’s
format, and averaging the resulting mutual-information scores.

Fix Python-3 syntax and clear Antimony state on conversions

Clear the internal Antimony translator before every format conversion to avoid side-effects from previous loads. Replace the deprecated `is` comparison with `==` for string literals. Log missing pySBOL warnings via RoadRunner logger instead of solely relying on Python warnings.

Make phrasedml optional and drop sbml2matlab import

Remove hard dependency on phrasedml by surrounding all imports and usage
with try/except blocks so OMEX/SED-ML handling gracefully degrades when
phrasedml is unavailable.  Also drop the unused sbml2matlab import from
Spyder startup lines and clean up some unreachable code and unused
imports.
Enable descriptor wallet support in wallet_send.py functional test

Wrap profiler enable/disable pairs into context manager

Replaced repeated _profile.enable()/_profile.disable() calls with a new
profiling_context() context manager and the nullcontext utility for the
non-profiling path. This simplifies the scheduler code and makes the
profiler scope handling exception-safe.

Split test/hook discovery from RegressionManager init

The RegressionManager now receives pre-discovered tests and hooks via
its constructor, and a new class-method `from_discovery` performs
the old auto-discovery. This makes the manager reusable for cases
where the caller already knows which tests to run.

Add task IDs and rich __repr__ for coroutines

Each cocotb task now carries a monotonic numeric ID and a concise,
debug-friendly string representation that shows its current state
(running, waiting on a trigger, finished, etc.) along with the
top-level coroutine name and live call-stack when available.
Replace repeated str.replace loops with str.translate table

Replace TxnActions with Operations for datastore mutations

Stop using the transaction-specific constants TxnActions.PUT/DELETE for regular datastore mutations. Introduce a new Operations enum with human-readable values "put" and "delete" to clearly separate transactional actions from entity operations.

Move Celery name helpers from tq_config to utils

Shift queue-name, module-name and annotation builders to the shared utils
module so they can be reused without depending on TaskQueueConfig.

Add async MonitOperator to query and control services

Introduces MonitOperator: a tornado-based client that talks to Monit’s
HTTP API to fetch XML status and issue start/stop/reload commands while
handling retries, timeouts, and back-pressure. Constants for process
states (running, stopped, missing, etc.) are also added to keep the API
clean.

Use external ZooKeeper client in DeploymentConfig

Stop creating a new KazooClient inside DeploymentConfig; instead the
caller is now responsible for supplying an already-started client.
This lets all services share the same ZooKeeper connection and removes
the hard-coded “read-only” flag.

Restart ZooKeeper watches on missing project nodes

When a project/configuration section is deleted and then recreated, the
original DataWatch is silently cancelled and further changes are missed.
This commit:

- Adds an exists() check in the watch callback to detect deletion.
- Introduces ensure_watch() to re-register the watch if it was dropped.
- Invokes ensure_watch() whenever the global manager refreshes its view,
  guarding against race windows between watch loss and restart.

The stop() method has been simplified to only close resources; the watch
itself is now (re)created on demand.

Add reserve_ids to block re-allocation of specific entity IDs

Introduces a new `reserve_ids` operation that accepts an iterable of
entity IDs and ensures the datastore will never re-allocate them.  
Both sequential and scattered ID spaces are handled, with minimal
Cassandra traffic when the counter is already high enough.

Return empty buffer instead of encoded proto on error

Stop encoding and returning partial or unused protocol buffer responses
when an exception is encountered; instead, return an empty string to
reduce unnecessary serialization overhead and clarify that no valid
response is produced.

Replace custom entity locking with reusable EntityLock class

Migrate groomer code from handcrafted acquire/release logic to the
shared EntityLock helper.  This removes duplicate retry/exception
handling and guarantees consistent lock semantics across the
code-base.

Add support for routing specific API calls to an external server

Enable the devappserver and remote_api_stub to send selected services
(primarily app_identity_service) to a separate API endpoint while the
rest continue to use the local API server. Introduce a new
--external_api_port flag and pass the address through to the
runtime so Python stubs can be configured accordingly.

Track entity groups used within each transaction

Persist the set of entity groups involved in a transaction so that
lock-related debugging and auditing tools can inspect them later.
Fix entity group lock handling to raise TimeoutError on acquire failure

Simplify rollback_transaction to take txid and raise on error

Removes unused imports and shifts protocol-buffer decoding / response building into the caller, making the core method synchronous and purely transactional.

Add endpoint for updating datastore indexes

Introduces /api/datastore/index/add to receive index.yaml content via POST,
validate it, persist the new indexes in ZooKeeper, and merge them with any
existing ones. Includes model classes for indexes and their properties with
YAML/JSON serialization support.

Use gossipinfo instead of ring to fetch node data

Replaces nodetool ring parsing with nodetool gossipinfo, eliminating the byte-unit parser and its helper exception. Adds command-line flags to skip sanity checks when the caller provides external guarantees.

Detect and skip HAProxy configs with duplicate ports

Prevent the routing layer from pushing an invalid HAProxy file when two
versions share the same port.  An explicit InvalidConfig exception is
raised during config generation, logged, and causes the reload to be
aborted.  Also introduce a VersionRoutingManager.stop() helper to
cleanly remove a version and introduce the guard changes needed to
handle empty version details.

Move commit transaction logic into request handler

Inline the former DatastoreDistributed.commit_transaction coroutine
directly into MainHandler where the commit request is handled,
eliminating an extra layer of indirection.

Add option to use custom service account for datastore backup

Lets users specify an alternate service-account when creating a backup, which is then used for all GCS operations (listing, writing and deleting objects). The account ID is passed through the mapper parameters, backup-completion handler, and `BackupInfoWriter`.

Obtain OAuth access tokens from Google using service account keys

Replaces JWT self-signing with real token exchange when service account
details are stored in ZooKeeper under the project's service_accounts
node. Falls back to placeholder tokens when no account is configured.
Includes HTTP request handling to Google's token endpoint and token
storage in AccessToken objects.

Support per-backup service accounts in UI

Move service account resolution into a new utils helper and let users pick an account when importing or restoring a backup.

Add support for __property__ metadata query

Enables datastore clients to enumerate a kind's indexed property names and the data types they store.

Store accuracy plots in per-group subdirectories

Replaces flat output layout with group-name subfolders; updates filename helpers accordingly.

Introduce RepoVersion class to simplify ABI checker

Gather all per-revision state into a new RepoVersion object and pass two
instances (old/new) to AbiChecker instead of ten separate arguments.

This removes the parallel dicts mbedtls_modules, old_dumps and new_dumps,
makes the API cleaner, and eliminates repeated parameter lists in method
signatures.

Fix origin tracking and improve UX in combine_metadata.py

Previously, only the last origin was accurately marked; earlier ones were silently set to "yes" for all strains. Now each strain gets correct yes/no flags for every input origin. Added explicit error messages for argument mismatches, clarified help text, and cleaned up variable usage.
Add helper functions for parsing renames and stripping prefixes

Add '.' alias for current dir selection

Enable '.' as shorthand to select tests, plans and stories located
under the current working directory in list, show, lint, export and
run commands.

Expand image aliases for Fedora releases

Teach the testcloud provisioner to resolve 'fedora', 'rawhide',
'f32', 'f-32', 'fedora-32', etc. into the correct qcow2 location
by automatically detecting the latest release numbers, rather than
hard-coding only Rawhide.

Move Guest class to tmt.steps.provision package

Relocate the Guest implementation from tmt.base into the provision step where it belongs, cleaning imports and adjusting the connect plugin import accordingly.
Make debug logs use imperative tense for clarity

Detect actual default branch from cloned repo

Replace hard-coded "master" expectations with runtime detection of the
repository’s default branch when no explicit ref is requested.

Collect guest package requirements from all steps

Adds a `requires()` method to every step and its plugins so the prepare
step can collect all necessary packages for every other step in a
single transaction.

Add updatable message utility for live progress reporting

Introduce `updatable_message()` context manager that prints a
single line that can be overwritten in-place; intended to show
live state changes during long-running operations.  
Use it in the Artemis provision step to display the guest state
with color coding while polling for readiness.  
Also extract and share the indentation helper used by both the
new utility and the existing `_indent()` method.

Replace ad-hoc retry sessions with shared helper

Unify all HTTP retry logic in a new context-manager wrapper around
requests.Session, centralizing configuration of retries, backoff,
timeouts and status/method allow-lists. Uses context-manager form
everywhere so sessions are closed deterministically.

Introduce dataclasses for structured guest state

Replace ad-hoc dictionaries with typed dataclasses (GuestData,
GuestSshData, ArtemisGuestData, PodmanGuestData, TestcloudGuestData)
to hold guest configuration and runtime state.  This gives static
typing, clearer defaults, and automatic serialization via
SerializableContainer, eliminating repetitive load()/save() boilerplate
in every plugin.

Fix reboot detection for SSH guests and increase test disk size

Replace unreliable thread-based SSH reboot detection with /proc/stat btime polling, ensuring we actually wait for the machine to restart. While at it, bump the test plan disk to 40 GB to prevent space issues during full runs.
Simplify plugin wake() API by removing unused keys argument

Store test identification keys as a dict in Result

Replace the single `id` string with a structured `ids` mapping that
preserves all known external identifiers (`extra-nitrate`, `extra-task`,
full fmf id) instead of picking the first one found.  
Update Polarion export/reporting code to read these keys separately and
ensure a match is found before publishing results.

Add pre-commit hooks for blanket noqa/type-ignore checks

Enables pygrep-hooks that reject unspecific `# noqa` and `# type: ignore` comments, and updates every existing occurrence to include the required error codes.

Add helper to import members with error handling

Introduces `import_member()` in `tmt.plugins` that safely loads a
specific class, function or variable from a module and returns it,
raising `GeneralError` on missing module or member.  
It replaces the hand-rolled import logic in `SerializableContainer`
and `_prenormalize_fmf_node` and adds unit tests for the new
function.

Introduce SpecBasedContainer and rename to/from_raw to to/from_spec

Adds documentation for the three conversion families (spec, serialized, dict)
and provides SpecBasedContainer for classes that need to round-trip between
Python objects and user-provided specification data (CLI or fmf).

Move guest wakeup logic to common ProvisionPlugin base

Instead of duplicating the wake() implementation in every provision plugin, apply the generic pattern in the base class once and remove the redundant overrides.

Log trial creation/resume and fix SOBOL seed on restart

AutoSearchJob now logs when a trial is newly created or resumed from a prior run.  
AxSearchJob ensures deterministic Sobol sampling after a resume by fixing the seed and skipping already-generated arms.

Update preprocessing script to use positional folder argument

Changed the CLI of preprocess.py from `--folder <name>` to a positional argument `<name>` to simplify usage. Extended the script to additionally generate a `dataset.yaml` file that captures dataset metadata (entity/relation counts, split sizes, filenames) and updated the dataset loader to read this file when present.

Add scoring mode for (s,o) pairs and delegate unknown combines

Introduces a new "s*o" combine mode that scores all relations for given
subject-object pairs.  
Unknown combine strings now fall back to the base RelationalScorer
instead of raising ValueError in each model scorer.  
Adds score_so method to KgeModel and disables it for ReciprocalRelationsModel.

Rename combine patterns asterisk to underscore

Standardize wildcard placeholders sp*, *po, s*o to sp_, _po, s_o across all models and documentation for clarity and consistency.

Use SelectionPredicateComposition for selection predicates

Replace core.PredicateComposition with a new subclass that preserves the correct schema when chaining boolean operations on selections. Updated tests to expect the new "param" key instead of the deprecated "selection" key.

Add group_nodes option to distribute()

Enables splitting MPI nodes into isolated groups so that nested calls
to distribute() execute only within their own group. Accept either
an integer (equal groups) or a list of integers (custom group sizes).

Add jobid/njobs CLI flags for parallel experiment splitting

Adds --jobid and --njobs to the yank script command so the same YAML
file can be used to shard experiments across multiple independent
processes. The ExperimentBuilder now selects only the subset of
experiments that fall within its slice, enabling safe parallel
execution without duplicate work.
Move imports to their call sites to speed up CLI startup

Speed up required-location checks by reusing Logic instance

Cache a single Logic instance and its initial state instead of creating
a new one for every call to check_location_required_for_paths().

Make call_module manage its own C API session

The function now creates and destroys a GMT API session internally, so
callers no longer need to obtain and pass a session pointer.

Introduce GMTSession to manage modern mode sessions

Replaced the public `begin` and `end` functions with an internal `GMTSession`
class that starts on import and auto-cleans on shutdown.  Users no longer have
to remember to call `begin`/`end`; one global session is always active.  
Updated docs and tests to reflect the simplified API, fixed a typo in the
module list, and cleaned up test file handling.

Replace GMTSession class with plain begin/end calls

Simplifies session handling by removing the stateful GMTSession wrapper.
The global session is now started with _begin() on import and ends via
atexit-registered _end(), eliminating a custom class and its tests.

Add --extensive mode to parallel.py race-testing

Enables a new --extensive flag that runs multiple long-running block-race
scenarios under the artificial -pvtest delay, exercising edge cases
where blocks of different/identical sizes arrive out of order.

Add reliable sync for getdata messages in p2p acceptblock test

Replace fragile sync_with_ping and open-coded polling with a new
sync_getdata helper that waits until specific inventory hashes are
requested.  Also switch from generic -debug to targeted net/req
debugging and tighten timing checks to reduce sporadic failures.

Add minValue support to perSecond and nonNegativeDerivative

Allow wrapping counters to reset at a custom minimum value by adding an
optional minValue parameter to perSecond() and nonNegativeDerivative().
It works symmetrically to the existing maxValue parameter, supporting
counters that start at a non-zero floor such as SNMP gauges or metrics
that reset to 1 instead of 0.

Add X-Supervisor-Token auth support for supervisor endpoints

Replace legacy Authorization header with X-Supervisor-Token where needed, update simulated supervisor to accept both mechanisms, and streamline header generation helpers.

Replace custom diff/formatting with jsoncomparison

- Dropped hand-rolled `pretty_print_combos` and `compare_combos`
- Switched to jsoncomparison.Compare for diffing combinations.json
- Added --verbose flag to print full output and diff on demand
- Switched logger.info for better CI visibility; removed dead imports

Add optional checksum verification to HTTP fetches

Allow callers to skip SHA-256 hash checks by passing is_check_hash=False. Internal listings now disable verification to speed metadata retrieval.

Return bytes directly from get_hash and drop redundant binascii calls

Consolidate hex-to-bytes conversion inside get_hash so callers no longer have to unhexlify the result, and let get_hash raise ChecksumDownloadFailure on empty or malformed checksums.

Add --autodesktop flag to auto-install missing desktop Qt

Automatically installs the required desktop Qt version when targeting Android or iOS, suppressing the existing warning.
Enable GCE routing simulation in multi-host tests
Enable PR re-testing via comment trigger with "[test]"

Add PR status updates to Jenkins PR automation

Introduce set-pending/-failure GitHub commit status updates at the
start and on failure of each test run.  
Rework payload handling to separate title/body from the JSON to avoid
parsing issues, and extract PR details directly for issue-comment
triggers. Update Jenkinsfile to mount bot-token secret and decouple
test orchestration into run_tests/update_pr_status helpers, while the
Python test runner no longer posts statuses itself.
Check available memory instead of total memory in tests

Add targeted GC around stream tests to curb memory spikes

Decorates every non-parametrized test function and those that vary
store_comp_size or data/buffer_size with run-gc helpers that
explicitly collect garbage before and after each test—except when
running on CI (TRAVIS or APPVEYOR) where the overhead is skipped.
This prevents intermittent OOM failures on memory-constrained
developers’ machines without slowing continuous-integration runs.
Fix broken line continuations in schema examples

Move OpenROAD placement defaults from tools to PDKs

PDKs now specify technology-specific OpenROAD defaults (place density,
pad/halo/channel values) instead of the tool hard-coding them.

Move trim() helper to siliconcompiler.utils

Relocate the docstring-cleaning trim() function from the docs extension into siliconcompiler.utils so it can be reused by schema.py and schemagen.py. Replace ad-hoc trimming in schema.py with the centralized helper.

Fix TCL manifest generation for lists, tuples and env vars

Add a dedicated helper to turn any SC value into a properly escaped TCL
literal.  This ensures lists/tuples are rendered as TCL lists, booleans
as "true"/"false", strings wrapped in {} to survive special characters,
and environment variables ($VAR) are rewritten as $env(VAR).  Update
the Tcl output routine to use the helper and add comprehensive tests
that read the produced manifest back in Tcl to verify correctness.
Fix TCL escaping to use double quotes for strings

Collect error/warning metrics from log regex matches

check_logfile now returns a dict counting matches per suffix and
automatically populates 'errors' and 'warnings' metrics when suffixes
named 'errors' or 'warnings' are present.

Updated docstrings and examples to use plural "errors" instead of
"error" to align with the new metric names.
Consolidate tool setup and accumulate error/warning metrics

Accept numpy arrays and enforce ascending order for band/channel

- Allow numpy.ndarray and numpy integer types for band and channel parameters.
- Automatically swap reversed ranges so the payload always lists min first.
- Pass cutout parameters explicitly to avoid missing values.
- Add docs and tests for 3-D velocity cutouts.

Validate SVO FPS query parameters before request

Adds an explicit check against a list of accepted query parameters and raises InvalidQueryError with a helpful message when unknown keys are supplied. Removes the previous remote test that relied on a server-side error.

Make DummyResponse/DummyConn use keyword defaults

Refactor test setup by replacing explicit None arguments with keyword-parameter defaults in DummyResponse.set_data and DummyConn.request, simplifying all call sites across JWST, Gaia and core TAP tests.

Add shared column_attrs fixture and simplify assertions

Replace repetitive, inline checks for column metadata in every test
with a single module-scoped fixture that provides pre-configured
astropy Columns.  This removes 100+ lines of boilerplate and the
private helper method __check_results_column.

Introduce reusable mock TAP fixtures for faster tests

Replace in-test setup code with module-scoped `mock_querier` and
`mock_querier_async` fixtures that build and cache a Gaia TAP instance
configured with canned HTTP responses.  Removes a dozen near-identical
server mocks and converts tests to use the new fixtures, cutting
per-test boilerplate and speeding up the suite.

Flatten test class into standalone functions

Remove the redundant TestTap class wrapper; all tests are now top-level pytest functions, which is the preferred style for projects that don’t share state between test cases.
Replace custom url_encode with standard urllib.parse.urlencode

Replace custom file reading with pathlib and drop unused utils.read_file_content

Remove the now-unused read_file_content helper from tap.xmlparser.utils and switch all test modules to Python 3 pathlib idioms: read test data directly from Path objects and drop ad-hoc data_path() helpers.
references:
Support CUDA stream on memory pool

Now, memory pool will have an arena (bins) for each stream
to avoid concurrent streams touch the same memory block

Complete overhaul of filter testing.

These tests are much more flexible now for when additional filters are added.

Use "import numpy as np" in the array_api submodule

This avoids importing everything inside the individual functions, but still is
preferred over importing the functions used explicitly, as most of them clash
with the wrapper function names.

Use _implementation on all functions that have it in the array API submodule

That way they only work on actual ndarray inputs, not array-like, which is
more inline with the spec.

Use better type signatures in the array API module

This includes returning custom dataclasses for finfo and iinfo that only
contain the properties required by the array API specification.

Make the array API left and right shift do type promotion

The spec previously said it should return the type of the left argument, but
this was changed to do type promotion to be consistent with all the other
elementwise functions/operators.

Implement the array API result_type() manually

np.result_type() has too many behaviors that we want to avoid in the array API
namespace, like value-based casting and unwanted type promotions. Instead, we
implement the exact type promotion table from the spec.

Fix for orphaned items that may develop from a failed watcher event.

- Also added optional (but on by default) silencing of verbose and useless botocore logs.

Add options to post metrics to queue

This commit adds an option to SM to post metrics to cloudwatch.
Metric data will be posted whenever scan queue items are added or
removed.

Use named field for command_template when generating ninja command.

The command template become easier to read with named field.

Rewrite custom_target template string substitution

Factor it out into a function in mesonlib.py. This will allow us to
reuse it for generators and for configure_file(). The latter doesn't
implement this at all right now.

Also includes unit tests.

Use the same function for detection of C and C++ compilers

The mechanism is identical which means there's a high likelihood of
unintended divergence. In fact, a slight divergence was already there.

Use an enum instead of strings for method names.

If a non-string value is passed as a method, reject this explicitly
with a clear error message rather than trying to match with it and
failing.

Add 'Compiler.get_display_language'

Use this when we print language-related information to the console and
via the Ninja backend.

Add ConfigToolDependency class

This class is meant abstract away some of the tedium of writing a config
tool wrapper dependency, and allow these instances to share some basic
code that they all need.

Enable searching system crossfile locations on more platforms

There's no reason not to also look in these places on Cygwin or OSX.  Don't
do this on Windows, as these paths aren't meaningful there.

Move test_cross_file_system_paths from LinuxlikeTests to AllPlatformTests.

Use include_directories for D impdirs.

Change the code to store D properties as plain data. Only convert them
to compiler flags in the backend. This also means we can fully parse D
arguments without needing to know the compiler being used.

Use test setups from the active (sub)project by default.

Replace the logic where a test setup with no project specifier defaults to
the main project with one that takes the test setup from the same
(sub)project from where the to-be-executed test has been read from.

Create a helper for checking if a string has a path component

This is used in a number of places, and in some places it is incomplete.
Use a helper to ensure it's used properly.

Fix b_ndebug=if-release option

Provide get_{type}_options_for_target() methods that unite {type} and builtin options.

Add macOS linker versioning information

This patch exploits the information residing in ltversion to set the
-compatibility_version and -current_version flags that are passed to the
linker on macOS.

Add 'install_mode' to all installable targets

This makes it possible to customize permissions of all installable
targets, such as executable(), libraries, man pages, header files and
custom or generated targets.

This is useful, for instance, to install setuid/setgid binaries, which
was hard to accomplish without access to this attribute.

Move to coredata some methods handling options

Those methods only use coredata object, so better just move them as a
coredata method.

Rename clike_langs to clink_langs for clarity

D is not a 'c-like' language, but it can link to C libraries. The same
might be true of Rust in the future and Go when we add support for it.

This contains no functionality changes.

Improve logging when dependency is anonymous

Various pieces of logging assume the dependency has a name, and aren't
grammatical if the dependency is '', so say it is anonymous instead.

Add new method: mlog.deprecation()

Instead of constructing it manually, use a helper.

Refactor getting the host system of a cross compiler

Use mesonlib.for_windows or mesonlib.for_cygwin instead of
reimplementing them.

Add CrossBuildInfo.get_host_system to shorten the repeated the code in
the mesonlib.for_<platform> methods.

Make `-std=` fallback remapping more robust

* The current version matching logic is brittle
  with respect to Clang. LLVM and Apple Clang use
  slightly different but nowadays overlapping
  version ranges. Instead, we now just check whether
  the compiler supports the given `-std=` variant
  and try its respective fallback instead of
  testing version ranges.

Use enum instead of `int` for compiler variants

* Enums are strongly typed and make the whole
  `gcc_type`/`clang_type`/`icc_type` distinction
  redundant.
* Enums also allow extending via member functions,
  which makes the code more generalisable.

Use a single ArgumentParser for all subcommands

This has the adventage that "meson --help" shows a list of all commands,
making them discoverable. This also reduce the manual parsing of
arguments to the strict minimum needed for backward compatibility.

Use correct environment for REGEN in VS backend.

Try to guess which VS Command Prompt was used for the Meson call.
If one is chosen invoke it before calling Meson in REGEN command.

Move the list of LLVM version suffixes to a common place

Both scan-build and llvm-config need the same list of LLVM version
suffixes. It is better to keep the list at a common place instead of
having several copies in different files, which is likely to become
out-of-sync when the list is updated.

Move git helper out into mesonlib for reuse

Reuse the git helper for `meson wrap` and `meson subprojects` so we
don't need to maintain the same git-colors-on-windows workarounds in
multiple places.

Refactor TestResult object initialization

Just add or alter attributes of the TestResult object, rather than many,
many invocations of the constructor with very similar arguments.

Define helper methods for TestResult to add the results of a step and
set the failure reason.

Convert test protocol into an enum

This gives us better type safety, and will be important as we add more
test methods

Delete redirected wrap files in subprojects purge

We need to store the original filename as well as whether the wrap was
redirected in order to properly purge the redirected wrap.

Add support for saving embeddings at intermediate epochs

Returns a list of intermediate embeddings in UMAP.embedding_list

Adjust UHV goals to new wonders

- second French goal now requires the Louvre and the Metropolitain instead of the Statue of Liberty
- second Mughal goal now requires Shalimar Gardens instead of Harmandir Sahib
- second American goal now also requires Brooklyn Bridge and Golden Gate Bridge

Update S3 storage driver so it suppots "region" constructor argument.

This way user can use this constructor class argument instead of using a
different driver class per region.

Also update code to return more user friendly error message if moved
permanently error is returned by the API.

Update setup.py so it doesn't rely on any functions from libcloud
packages.

This way we avoid having setup.py depend on typing, requests and other
modules libcloud depends on.

Add new storage API methods for downloading part of an object (range
download) and implement it for the S3 and local storage drivers.

Implement Range downloads for the Azure Blobs driver and move common
method which can be re-used by S3 based and Azure drivers to the base
driver class.

Allow user to pass "timeout" argument to ScriptDeployment and
ScriptFileDeployment class.

With this argument, user can specify optional command run timeout for
those deployment steps.

Update AWS error response XML parsing code so we also handle situation
where response doesn't have a namespace.

It looks like that in some cases AWS returns error response without a
namespace which previous version of the code didn't handle correctly.

Add tests which verify that all OpenStack driver can be instantiated
with all the supported auth versions.

NOTE: Those tests will fail right now due to the regressions being
introduced recently which breaks auth for some versions.

Support aliasing of input files and querying from stdin.

Because an input file might be referenced by its alias now, we
removed various 'os.path.realpath' normalizations and use
'normalize_file_path' more selectively now.

Handle special translation needed for 'likelihood' and 'concat' functions

Also slightly refactored and cleaned up translation of function expressions.

Handle translation of new computed virtual graph patterns

- uses new virtual graph function machinery for translation
- ensures we don't try to create indexes on virtual tables

Support dont-optimize switch on all or individual match clauses

This will use a CROSS JOIN operator where appropriate which in SQLite
will disable the query optimizer for those joins and process the joins
in the order listed.

Change to use argument name "geom" consistently.

Previously we had a mix of "geom" and "ref_geom" in Gammapy.

Add auto-generated unique names

- add auto-generated unique names for model and dataset on init and copy
- force unicity on datasets and skymodels

Add processing options for SkyModel and SkyDiffuseCube 

Add options to apply or not psf and edisp to SkyModel and SkyDiffuseCube

Add shorter tags for models

Redefine most of models tags with a list including shorter aliases to be used with model.create(tag) and in YAML serialization. By default the tag returned in model.to_dict() is the 0th tag which is also the class name.

Add option to remove default output in models yaml file

Add option full_output (True by default) to model.to_yaml() and .to_dict(). Switching to False remove the entries for min, max, frozen and error if they are the same than the class defaults or nan.

Add PiecewiseBrokenPowerLawSpectralModel

Add PiecewiseBrokenPowerLawSpectralModel, a generalised broken power law  defined by a set of energy and intensity values (nodes) that are piecewise connected by power laws.

Add ignore_comments to documentation

- Also change data parsing functions to use 'ignore_data_comments'
  rather than 'ignore_comments'. This clarifies the difference between
  the two flags since 'ignore_data_comments' is used in parsing the data
  section and 'ignore_comments' is used in parsing header sections.

Add functionality to update listener/STT config

When a new configuration is discovered the producer and consumer is shutdown, the config is read and a new producer-consumer pair is launched.

Make handlers for single scheduled events one shot

- add_event() now accepts the parameter once, registring the event as a one shot event.
- remove_event for non-existing events is handled
- added a test for this

Use function attributes for intent decorators
This prevents needing to use a shared list which misbehaves when multiple skills initialize at once

Make skill ids use skill folder
This is necessary because in Python 3, hash(x) changes every single start of the application. Using the skill folder makes it consistent. In addition, the skill folder makes it easier to debug parts of the application in comparison to using something like an md5sum

Support for audio seek

The audioservice can now jump forward and backward in the audio stream/file

The functionality is accessed via the audioservice class's seek_forward(),
seek_backward() and seek() methods

Replace hashed meta with skill_gid as identifier

This also removes the notion of an owner skill and all skills may update settings on the server.

Update old style metaclasses

the old "__metaclass__" has been ignored since the switch to python 3
this restores the metaclass functionality by updating it to the new
class kwarg syntax

Make register_intent decorator register all intent types

This makes the register_intent decorator work for all types of intents,
both Adapt and Padatious.

Make execute_test less complex

Split the long function into several smaller ones just retaining the
main logic.

Move listen trigger to last chunk of sentence

If rendering a chunk of a sentence takes too long time, the audio queue
may run out and trigger the listening.

This moves the listening trigger to after the last chunk.

Simplify and clean up curate_cache

- create helper functions for getting file stats and removing files in
order of age
- create wrapper function for turning MB into bytes

Fix remove_fallback()

remove_fallback() was mainly created for use internally during shutdown
and required the wrapped callable to be able to remove a handler. This
makes it general, using a mapping to find the wrapper from a handler if
needed. The method now also returns the success/failure status

Add wait_for_message() method to messagebus client

- Refactor message waiting into a MessageWaiter class to be able to use the
  same code in both wait_for_message and wait_for_response.
- Add some basic unittests

Add ProcessStatus class

ProcessStatus tracks the process status and allows callbacks on changes
and status queries over the messagebus.

StatusCallbackMap is used to setup the callbacks

ProcessState is an enum tracking the different states.

Use pyglet.options['ffmpeg_libs_win'] to give the FFmpeg lib filenames.

This has to be used on Windows, as the dll names have a format like
avcode-57.dll, appending the version number at the end.

Refactor FFmpegSource

Using 2 queues for video packets and audio packets. Whenever the
queues have space, more packets are read from the stream.

This work will allow to remove more easily the audio thread in
favor of a scheduled call to refill the audio player.

Remove thread in DirectSound

We use instead pyglet.clock.schedule_interval_soft to regularly
refill the DirectSound buffer with new audio data.

Fix Player when playing audio source with silent audio driver.

When there is no video but only audio in the Source and the audio driver is silent,
the Player was never finished playing. Now it dispatches correctly the "on_eos"
event after the duration.

Change schema for population.

    MODEL cols AS stattype has become SET STATTYPE OF cols TO st

Reasoning: The word MODEL is confusing here, we are setting the statistical
data type so we should name the command just that.

Make loom process constraints for conditional mutual information.

Before, constraints (i.e. conditions were ignored) for mutual information
with loom.

Clear previously-loaded models in Antimony when getting a new one.

Repeated calls to 'loada' were causing steady increases in used memory because the Antimony library was storing every model.  This clears them out each time, since a tellurium user doesn't care about retrieving old models.

Also clean up a couple of warnings.

Drop phrasedml and sbml2matlab requirement.

phrasedml and sbml2matlab don't exist for 3.10 yet, so we need to adjust code and fail gracefully when trying to import them.

Fix wallet_send.py wallet setup to work with descriptors

Fixes the wallet setup so this test works with descriptor wallets. Also
enabled explicit descriptor and legacy wallet testing in the test
runner.

Use context managers to handle profiling

This avoids needing to remember to disable the profiler by every return statement, and reads more cleanly than using a `try` / `finally`

Add ability to construct RegressionManager with test/hook list

Standard constructor that uses discovery has been moved to the
`from_discovery` class method.

Improve __repr__ for RunningTask objects.

Displays task name, status, and current coroutine.
If the task is pending on a trigger, displays the trigger.
If the task is finished, displays the outcome.

Convert resolve() to str.translate().

New translation table class _ResolveTable provides resolve functionality
and improves performance.

This preserves current behavior of COCOTB_RESOLVE_X = RANDOM, where
all instances of the character are translated to the same value.

Create separate set of constants for operations

This is to differentiate between transaction table values and
entity operations.

Move shared static functions to utils

This allows other modules like the Celery worker to use them.

Add MonitOperator

This uses Monit's XML API and groups closely-timed Monit reloads
together.

Allow DeploymentConfig to take a KazooClient

This makes it easier to reuse the KazooClient for other things.

Reduce unnecessary "exists" watches

This allows managers to stop watches if it's clear they are no
longer needed.

Implement the datastore_v4.AllocateIds API

This allows clients to ensure that a list of entity IDs are never
re-allocated.

Simplify datastore error handling

If an error code is defined, the response body does not need to be
specified. This prevents encoding issues in cases when a response
message has required fields.

Use the EntityLock in the groomer

The allows the groomer to make index modifications under a lock
without having to create transaction IDs.

Allow Python runtime to use an external API server

If given an external api port, the Python runtime will use it to
make App Identity calls.

Attach list of groups to transaction node

This allows the transaction groomer to track down which entity
groups might have an entity lock that needs to be cleared after
the transaction is resolved.

Allow group locks to persist when commits fail

This prevents other clients from writing to a group before a large
batch is fully applied.

Simplify rollback_transaction method

This moves the protobuffer-related work to the proper layer.

Handle UpdateIndexes calls

This adds index definitions to a project's ZooKeeper node if they
aren't there yet.

Improve speed of rebalance script

This removes the call to `nodetool ring`, which can get
unreasonably slow as the amount of data in a BOP cluster increases.

It also adds a couple flags that allow the `nodetool status` call
to be skipped if the user is already sure the sanity checks will
pass.

Stop routing deleted versions

This ensures that deleted versions are absent from the HAProxy
configuration file when HAProxy is reloaded.

Move protobuffer handling to different level

Parsing the commit request and populating the response should
happen at the protobuffer interface level rather than in
DatastoreDistributed.

Add service account name field to backup form

This allows users to schedule a mapreduce-backed job with a
custom service account name for backing up to an arbitrary GCS
account.

Support the service_account_name parameter

This allows GetAccessTokenRequests to specify a custom service
account for generating an authentication token.

Allow custom service accounts for restore ops

This extends the datastore admin interface to allow custom
service accounts for restore operations.

Add support for property metadata queries

This allows clients to request a list of property names and types
for all kinds in a given namespace.

Add subdirectories for aggregates

To enable multiple aggregates in a clean way in the output directory will now contain a sub-directory for each group for which the aggregate function is called

Add RepoVersion class to make handling of many arguments easier

There are a number of arguments being passed around, nearly all of
which are duplicated between the old and new versions. Moving these
into a separate class should hopefully make it simpler to follow
what is being done.

Improve combine metadata script

1. More detailed help message
2. Helpful errors printed if assertions fail
3. Encoding of metadata origin now uses explicit "yes"/"no" values
rather than using the empty string.

Refactor sanitizer transform logic

Move logic to parse mapping of old to new column names and strip
prefixes into their own functions with tests. This refactoring
simplifies the code in the main body of the sanitizer script.

Support selecting objects under the current folder

Add a special single dot notation for filtering stories, plans and
tests under the current working directory. Update documentation
and usage messages accordingly.

Support short Fedora compose aliases in testcloud

Adds support for 'fedora' as the latest released Fedora, 'rawhide'
for the latest Rawhide plus 'fedora-X', 'f-X' and 'fX' shortcuts.

Move the Guest class from base to steps.provision

Here it makes more sense as it is related to provision classes.

Adjust the minute provision debug messages wording

Just a couple of minor cosmetic adjustments to make the messages
consistent with the rest.

Adjust the default branch handling for libraries

Detect the default branch and store it after cloning the repo.
This seems to make the implementation a bit more readable.

Implement a generic `requires` for all plugins

Add support for gathering packages required on the guest to all
supported plugins to allow easier future extension if needed.

Add a nice provisioning progress to Artemis plugin

Artemis plugin now displays the sequence of of guest states
as its provisioning progresses. This has been implemented as
a reusable primitive context manager, coupled with a small
refactoring of code taking care of indentation.

Enhance tmt.utils.retry_session with timeout support

`retry_session` is now usable as a context manager, and accepts a
timeout to honor for each HTTP request.

Current `retry_session` was overlapping with similar functionality in
`artemis` plugin, so merged both together and threw context manager in
too, because `retry_session` was used in that manner exclusively.

Convert guest implementations to use serializable container for load/save

Instead of custom load/save methods, use those based on dataclasses. We
gain type annotations, automagic conversion from/to YAML, no need for
explicit moves of fields between instances and serialized data.

Reboot has to check for boot time

Previous attempt with closing connection was not succesful as shown by
/tests/execute/reboot/reuse_provision

btime in /proc/stat is boot time in seconds since epoch and reboot()
will make sure that it has changed

Adds disk requirement for tests/full which is helps with testing

Remove unused keys parameter from wake() methods

This seems to be no longer used, and makes `wake()` more complicated
than necessary.

Unify Polarion case searching

Save and load ids to/from results.yaml.
Add constant for extra identification keys.
Raise ReportError on TC not found in Polarion.

Replace blank "type: ignore" with more specific waivers

Using mypy's error codes, waivers can target the actual erorr, leaving
space for other kind of violations to not be suppressed.

Add a helper for importing a member from a module

This primitive appeared twice already, and follows the same
scenario: import a module, then locate a member (a class, usually)
in the module, and catch possible errors along the way.

Document & correct use of class conversion methods

Recently added `{to,from}_{serialized,raw,dict}` methods for various
conversions were poorly documented, and sometimes even wrongly used.
This patch adds a short summary on when to use them, and fixes some
sub par bits around the code.

Drop various guest `wake()` methods in favor of parent class

They all do the same things anyway: instantiate a guest class, with
given data, pass parent and name down the stream. A base class can do
all of this.

Fix resuming of SOBOL generator during ax search

This is done by fixing the seed and regenerating trials already performed.

Support for dataset-specific configurations and metadata

preprocess now creates a dataset.yaml file with information about
the dataset.

Add support for relation prediction

Added a score_so method to KgeModel for this purpose and a default
implementation in RelationalScorer (which is currently used by all models).

Rename queries sp*/s*o/*po to sp_/s_o/_po

This makes them valid identifiers, which allows to use query types as
configuration keys (for example).

Define SelectionPredicateComposition

Made a new class SelectionPredicateComposition to allow use of ~,&,| with certain PredicateCompositions.  Rewrote test_filter_transform_selection_predicates to match the new syntax.

Add MPI parallelization on different MPI communicators.

This is necessary to parallelize functions that are also parallelized.

Add jobid and njobs argument to script command.

This allows to run multiple experiments from the same script in several parallel executions of YANK.

Move CLI imports into functions for speed

In order to prevent the CLI from taking long times due to importing everything, especially when the user mis-types a command for docopt to handle, import statements for the CLI functions have been moved to the actual functions instead of the module header

Improve performance of path hint generation

Avoid instantiating tons of different logic instances and just reuse the same instance by resetting its state every time it's needed.

Create and destroy C sessions inside call_module

Removes the need to always do this when using the C API. It's what the
command line app does anyway so it's not wasteful.

Hide away session management

Implement a GMTSession class to handle calling begin and end. Use it as
a global (package level) session. This way, each script/notebook uses
a single session. begin and end are no longer public API functions.

Replace the global GMTSession with 'atexit'

No need for the class or the global instance. Register 'end' with
'atexit' to make sure end is called when exiting Python.

Add 4 block attack scenarios to PV python testing

Also add the needed option -pvtest which slows down the checking
of inputs by putting a sleep time of 1 second for each input to
check.  This allows up to simulate very long to validate blocks
used in the attack scenarios.

Improve reliablility of p2p-acceptblock.py

Numerous timing issues do with the the multi-threading and also
the requestmanager. Better to no rely on sync_with_ping() and also
we have to handle getheaders requests and subsequent multi hash
getdata requests.

Add a minValue option to nonNegativeDerivative and perSecond

It works in a way similar to maxValue: when the counter wraps, instead of
producing a null value, it computes the difference assuming the counter wrapped
to minValue.

Use alternate headers for HA auth requests

When sending a "Authorization: Bearer" header to the supervisor's /auth endpoint, the header gets used to authorize the addon and then _also_ authorize against HA which fails.  This changes requests made to the /auth enpoint so they use the "X-Supervisor-Token" header to avoid the conflict.

Use library instead of ad-hoc code

This replaces `pretty_print_combos` with `json.dumps`, and
`compare_combos` with `jsoncomparison.Compare`.

Allow `MetadataFactory.fetch_http` to skip sha256

`MetadataFactory.fetch_http` must often download HTML pages, not
Updates.xml files. download.qt.io does not store checksums for these
files, so this particular function must be allowed to download these
pages without using a checksum.

Fix implementation of `helper.get_hash`

Causes `get_hash` to verify the hash length, and check that the hash can
be unhexlified properly.

Fixes the interface for `get_hash` so that the caller does not have to
run `binascii.unhexlify` or verify its output.

Add CLI option to install desktop qt automatically

This change also causes aqt to emit a warning when the option is not
turned on and the expected desktop Qt is not found.

Add test to simulate GCE instance setup

This change adds a test that sets up hosts' addressing and routing as it
is on a GCE instance, and checks that we still get connectivity between
workloads on different hosts.

Allow tests to be run on demand

With this change, a string "[test]" can be added as a comment to a pull
request by a whitelisted user to initiate testing on a pull request

Refactor to update pull requests with pending status

This commit refactors code to update the pull request with a pending
status at the earliest possible time.

Additionally, this refactor includes fixes an issue where unexpected
characters in the pull request title or body caused issues parsing
github webhook payload json

Check for available memory instead of its total amount in tests

This change prevents the python interpreter from triggering the
OOM-killer while trying to use/allocate more memory than available on
the system.

Reduce pressure on memory in stream tests

This change runs the python garbage collector before and after each
stream test.

The garbage collector is disabled in the CI since it has a significant
impact on the duration of the jobs (which are time constrained in the CI).

Fix multiline strings in schema examples

Using '\' or multiline strings results in extra whitespace, so it seems
best to use Python's automatic concatenation of adjacent strings.

Remove PDK-specific var defaults from openroad.py

We shouldn't be hardcoding tech-specific values in tool setup scripts,
so we should use the new ['pdk', 'variable'] parameter to drive these.

In order to support user overrides, we'll still drive them through the
['eda', ... 'variable'] keypath in the TCL script.

Fix RST parsing in schemagen

- Use Python standardized docstring "trim" function to preserve newlines
  and indentation in schelp strings.
- Fix schemagen parse_rst() to handle multiline text

Make _print_tcl() more robust

- Use {} to escape strings, so that we can have spaces and newlines
- Dump tuples as lists to avoid parsing
- Make sure envvar syntax gets subbed in anywhere in string

Tweak string escape approach

Use "" instead of {} to remove persistent backslashes in front of curly
braces in string.

Make tool regex set errors/warnings metrics

- "errors" and "warnings" suffix is special case
- Also update docs for relevant schema param and check_logfile()

Make regex errors/warnings additive, add reports

- Enables tools to extract additional errors/warnings from other logs
- Add logfiles under reports to reduce boilerplate, the logfiles always
  belong if regex is used

Add a spectral cutout example

Also include support for numpy arrays for band and channel, and autocorrect the band and channel values to be in ascending order

Validate `svo_fps` query parameter names locally

`SvoFpsClass.data_from_svo()` now checks the names of the query
parameters and only connects with the server if all names are valid.

Simplify setting DummyResponse data in TAP+ tests

`DummyResponse` is used in `esa/jwst` and `gaia` tests for mimicking
server responses. Now the response data can be specified by only setting
the parameters that have non-default values.

Simplify column attribute checking in `gaia` tests

The function `__check_results_column()` tested if the attributes (e.g.
description) of the columns of the query results match the expectation.
This function is now replaced with
`astropy.table.BaseColumn.attrs_equal()`, and the comparison data is now
provided by a `pytest` fixture.

Reduce duplication in setting up `gaia` tests

The new module level fixtures allowed removing setup code from many
tests.

Remove `TestTap` class from `gaia` tests

Grouping the tests together in a test class served no purpose and
eliminating the class removed a level of indentation.

Remove `utils.tap.conn.TapConn.url_encode()`

The removed method simply called the standard library
`urllib.parse.urlencode()`.

Remove an utility function for reading test data

`astroquery.utils.tap.xmlparser.utils.read_file_content()` has been
replaced with the standard library `pathlib.Path.read_text()`.
Furthermore, in the modules where multiple test functions previously
used `read_file_content()` to read the data files, they are now read
once at the module level instead.
